  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 18, 2023 AT 6:00 PM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design
Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City at
(626) 300­0713 or at planning@cityofsanmarino.org at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the Design Review Committee may teleconference into the meeting without
noticing each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public
meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID 19)
As a precaution to protect staff, our constituents, and officials, it is recommended that
members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s
current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged
provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to Planning@CityofSanMarino.org before or
  during the meeting prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during
  public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time.

  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION please contact the Planning Division at (626) 300­0713. A
copy of the staff reports under review at this Design Review Committee meeting will be
available for public review by the end of the day January, 13, 2023, on the City’s website at:
www.CityofSanMarino.org.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Suzanne Torgeson, Member Raymond Cheng, Member Rick Chou, Member Joyce
Garsoulis­Batnij, Vice Chair Sharon Mequet, Chair Christa Lakon

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Community
Development Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design
Review Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design
Review Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

1.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­50 AT 1765 HILLIARD DRIVE TO REMOVE NATURAL WOOD
  SHAKES AND INSTALL CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL SHAKE TL
  COMPOSITION SHINGLE ROOFING MATERIAL IN THE AGED BARK
  COLOR
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee:1. Determine that based on the
  whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1 (Existing facilities), and
  that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2. Find that the
  proposed project is compatible with the Legal Neighborhood and with the existing
  structure itself; and 3. Approve the project with CertainTeed Presidential Shake TL
  composition shingle roofing material in the either the Aged Bark or Autumn Blend
  colors with the added condition that the conditions for composition shingle roofing
  material listed on the City’s Pre­Approved Roof Materials, Colors, and Applications
  List shall be applied.

2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­57 AT 2283 HUNTINGTON DRIVE FOR A NEW WALL SIGN TO AN
  EXISTING COMMERCIAL SPACE. (KT ENTERPRISE LLC)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee:1. Determine that based on the
  whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301,(g), and that there is no
  substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption
  pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2. Find that the proposed
  signage is compatible with signage found on the adjacent commercial structures; and
  3. Approve the project as proposed.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

3.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee approve the
  regular meeting of December 7, 2022.

DIRECTOR'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Design Review
Committee and the public of any matters of interest.
